parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the control handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It regulates the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle to control internal valves.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to open or close the water flow, providing smooth manual control.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main cylindrical body of the faucet, made of stainless steel to support internal water channels and provide structural integrity.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal plumbing components and connects the faucet to the sink and water supply.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a stable base for the switch and spout.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved outlet tube of the faucet, made of stainless steel for corrosion resistance and aesthetic appeal.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the internal valve to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel in some designs to adjust the direction of water flow, but in this model, it appears fixed.
